defect.reproducer: Copy bridge.yaml to /tmp/pr07-bridge-broken.yaml and change only the IMU entry gz_topic_name from /vehicle/imu to /vehicle/imu_typo; start the single launch with that copy. ros2 topic info -v still reports one BEST_EFFORT publisher, timeout 5s ros2 topic echo /vehicle/imu --once exits 124. Probe sees zero IMU messages while camera, lidar, odometry and /clock are alive.
defect.root_cause: The bridge subscribes to a nonexistent Gazebo IMU topic. Matching ROS name and existing publisher do not establish data delivery. gz topic -i/-e show the actual source /vehicle/imu is publishing gz.msgs.IMU with imu_link frame.
defect.proof_after: Stop the defective launch, then start the same single launch with corrected bridge.yaml. ros2 topic echo /vehicle/imu --once succeeds; healthy probe receives 1386 IMU messages. Twist values match on ROS/Gazebo transports, odometry changes and real body motion is verified. Evidence is in headless.txt and sensors.json.
